annotations.label: TTFX driver #634
annotations.description: The TTFX driver instruments the task script for per-phase gc and compile stats and repeats it with the GC off (julia-buildkite#634). Its added statements cost about a millisecond of run on every task until julia-buildkite#635.

annotations.label: TTFX driver #635
annotations.description: The TTFX driver keeps its instrumentation out of the timed windows (julia-buildkite#635), removing the fixed cost of about a millisecond of run per task that julia-buildkite#634 had added.
